references.text: Proverbs of Solomon, which compare wisdom's invitation to a meal with folly's invitation, can be seen as a precursor to Jesus' parable of the wedding feast.
Isaiah speaks of the Lord's feast for all peoples, a feast with the finest dishes, which can be viewed as a foreshadowing of Jesus' parable of the wedding feast.

Jesus' mention that many will come from east and west and take their places in the kingdom of heaven, while the children of Israel are cast out, can be seen in light of the parable of the wedding feast where the invited guests reject the invitation.
The parable of the great banquet in Luke has parallels to the parable of the wedding feast in Matthew, where the invited guests find excuses not to come.
